title: SetuptoolsDeprecationWarning: setup.py install is deprecated in colcon build: harmless, hidden by current colcon, and which pip setuptools versions break ament_python, measured
excerpt: The setup.py install and easy_install warnings appeared only with colcon-core 0.15.2, not 0.21.3, and builds and ros2 run still worked. Pip setuptools 58.2.0 failed on Jazzy and Lyrical, 68.2.0 failed everywhere, 71+ failed on Humble's old packaging. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
